result.path_rule: algo.SPpaths decides: strongest path per flagged Work; counted if every hop is evidenced and each hop weight is ≥ 0.5; counted retraction blocks only when the hop into the retracted work is included, relies, or uses_data_or_method (weight ≥ 0.85); a counted retraction reached only via mention or background is warn (cites a review that mentions a retracted trial; the review did not appear to rely on it); counted + EoC → warn; flagged with an unverified hop → warn (can't verify); a hop below 0.5 → pass (cites a flagged study only in passing). Direct 1-hop citation of a retracted work still blocks. A multiplied path-strength floor is not applied. Zero SPpaths rows is a pass; PATHS_TO_NOTICE is not a second verdict. Python PATH_RULE is not a verdict. If the algorithm errors, exit 3.

remediation_clusters.call:
CALL algo.WCC({nodeLabels: ['Work'], relationshipTypes: ['RESTS_ON']})
YIELD node, componentId
WITH node, componentId
OPTIONAL MATCH (flag:Notice)-[:FLAGS]->(node)
WITH componentId,
     collect(DISTINCT node.doi) AS work_dois,
     [d IN collect(DISTINCT flag.doi) WHERE d IS NOT NULL] AS notice_dois,
     [t IN collect(DISTINCT flag.type) WHERE t IS NOT NULL] AS notice_types
WHERE size(notice_dois) > 0
MATCH (a:Answer)-[:CITES]->(:Source)-[:RESTS_ON]->(w:Work)
WHERE w.doi IN work_dois
RETURN componentId,
       work_dois,
       notice_dois,
       notice_types,
       collect(DISTINCT a.id) AS answer_ids,
       collect(DISTINCT a.engine) AS engines

algorithm.name: algo.SPpaths
algorithm.cypher:
MATCH (a:Answer {id: $answer_id})-[:CITES]->(s:Source)
MATCH p0 = (s)-[:RESTS_ON*1..2]->(w)
MATCH (n:Notice)-[:FLAGS]->(w:Work)
WITH DISTINCT s, w, n
CALL algo.SPpaths({sourceNode: s, targetNode: w, relTypes: ['RESTS_ON'], relDirection: 'outgoing', maxLen: 2, weightProp: 'cost'})
YIELD path, pathCost
WITH s, w, n, path, pathCost, relationships(path) AS rels
RETURN s.url AS source_url,
       s.title AS source_title,
       w.doi AS root_doi,
       w.title AS root_title,
       w.year AS root_year,
       w.first_author AS root_author,
       n.doi AS notice_doi,
       n.type AS notice_type,
       n.label AS notice_label,
       n.date AS notice_date,
       n.source AS notice_source,
       length(path) AS hops,
       reduce(score = 0.0, r IN rels | score + coalesce(r.cost, 20.0)) AS sp_cost,
       reduce(score = 1.0, r IN rels | score * coalesce(r.weight, 0.0)) AS path_score,
       [x IN nodes(path) | {doi: x.doi, title: x.title, url: x.url, year: x.year, first_author: x.first_author}] AS steps,
       [r IN rels | {weight: r.weight, reliance: r.reliance, sentence: r.sentence, evidence_from: r.evidence_from, judged: r.judged, cost: r.cost, source_url: r.evidence_url, fetched_at: r.evidence_fetched_at, content_hash: r.evidence_sha256}] AS hops_evidence
ORDER BY sp_cost ASC, hops ASC
LIMIT 40

impact.cypher:
MATCH (n:Notice)-[:FLAGS]->(w:Work)
WHERE n.doi = $doi OR w.doi = $doi
OPTIONAL MATCH p = (s:Source)-[:RESTS_ON*1..2]->(w)
OPTIONAL MATCH (a:Answer)-[:CITES]->(s)
WITH n, w, a, s, p, relationships(p) AS rels
WHERE p IS NOT NULL OR a IS NULL
WITH n, w, a, s,
     CASE WHEN p IS NULL THEN false ELSE ALL(r IN rels WHERE coalesce(r.sentence, '') <> '' AND coalesce(r.weight, 0.0) >= 0.5) END AS counted
RETURN n.doi AS notice_doi,
       n.type AS notice_type,
       n.label AS notice_label,
       n.date AS notice_date,
       n.source AS notice_source,
       w.doi AS root_doi,
       w.title AS root_title,
       w.year AS root_year,
       [id IN collect(DISTINCT a.id) WHERE id IS NOT NULL] AS answer_ids,
       [e IN collect(DISTINCT a.engine) WHERE e IS NOT NULL] AS engines,
       [u IN collect(DISTINCT s.url) WHERE u IS NOT NULL] AS source_urls,
       [id IN collect(DISTINCT CASE WHEN counted THEN a.id END) WHERE id IS NOT NULL] AS counted_answer_ids,
       size([id IN collect(DISTINCT a.id) WHERE id IS NOT NULL]) AS answer_count,
       size([u IN collect(DISTINCT s.url) WHERE u IS NOT NULL]) AS source_count

algorithm.name: algo.SPpaths
algorithm.cypher:
MATCH (a:Answer {id: $answer_id})-[:CITES]->(s:Source)
MATCH p0 = (s)-[:RESTS_ON*1..2]->(w)
MATCH (n:Notice)-[:FLAGS]->(w:Work)
WITH DISTINCT s, w, n
CALL algo.SPpaths({sourceNode: s, targetNode: w, relTypes: ['RESTS_ON'], relDirection: 'outgoing', maxLen: 2, weightProp: 'cost'})
YIELD path, pathCost
WITH s, w, n, path, pathCost, relationships(path) AS rels
RETURN s.url AS source_url,
       s.title AS source_title,
       w.doi AS root_doi,
       w.title AS root_title,
       w.year AS root_year,
       w.first_author AS root_author,
       n.doi AS notice_doi,
       n.type AS notice_type,
       n.label AS notice_label,
       n.date AS notice_date,
       n.source AS notice_source,
       length(path) AS hops,
       reduce(score = 0.0, r IN rels | score + coalesce(r.cost, 20.0)) AS sp_cost,
       reduce(score = 1.0, r IN rels | score * coalesce(r.weight, 0.0)) AS path_score,
       [x IN nodes(path) | {doi: x.doi, title: x.title, url: x.url, year: x.year, first_author: x.first_author}] AS steps,
       [r IN rels | {weight: r.weight, reliance: r.reliance, sentence: r.sentence, evidence_from: r.evidence_from, judged: r.judged, cost: r.cost, source_url: r.evidence_url, fetched_at: r.evidence_fetched_at, content_hash: r.evidence_sha256}] AS hops_evidence
ORDER BY sp_cost ASC, hops ASC
LIMIT 40

impact.cypher:
MATCH (n:Notice)-[:FLAGS]->(w:Work)
WHERE n.doi = $doi OR w.doi = $doi
OPTIONAL MATCH p = (s:Source)-[:RESTS_ON*1..2]->(w)
OPTIONAL MATCH (a:Answer)-[:CITES]->(s)
WITH n, w, a, s, p, relationships(p) AS rels
WHERE p IS NOT NULL OR a IS NULL
WITH n, w, a, s,
     CASE WHEN p IS NULL THEN false ELSE ALL(r IN rels WHERE coalesce(r.sentence, '') <> '' AND coalesce(r.weight, 0.0) >= 0.5) END AS counted
RETURN n.doi AS notice_doi,
       n.type AS notice_type,
       n.label AS notice_label,
       n.date AS notice_date,
       n.source AS notice_source,
       w.doi AS root_doi,
       w.title AS root_title,
       w.year AS root_year,
       [id IN collect(DISTINCT a.id) WHERE id IS NOT NULL] AS answer_ids,
       [e IN collect(DISTINCT a.engine) WHERE e IS NOT NULL] AS engines,
       [u IN collect(DISTINCT s.url) WHERE u IS NOT NULL] AS source_urls,
       [id IN collect(DISTINCT CASE WHEN counted THEN a.id END) WHERE id IS NOT NULL] AS counted_answer_ids,
       size([id IN collect(DISTINCT a.id) WHERE id IS NOT NULL]) AS answer_count,
       size([u IN collect(DISTINCT s.url) WHERE u IS NOT NULL]) AS source_count

queries.name: wcc_clusters
queries.cypher:
CALL algo.WCC({nodeLabels: ['Work'], relationshipTypes: ['RESTS_ON']})
YIELD node, componentId
WITH node, componentId
OPTIONAL MATCH (flag:Notice)-[:FLAGS]->(node)
WITH componentId,
     collect(DISTINCT node.doi) AS work_dois,
     [d IN collect(DISTINCT flag.doi) WHERE d IS NOT NULL] AS notice_dois,
     [t IN collect(DISTINCT flag.type) WHERE t IS NOT NULL] AS notice_types
WHERE size(notice_dois) > 0
MATCH (a:Answer)-[:CITES]->(:Source)-[:RESTS_ON]->(w:Work)
WHERE w.doi IN work_dois
RETURN componentId,
       work_dois,
       notice_dois,
       notice_types,
       collect(DISTINCT a.id) AS answer_ids,
       collect(DISTINCT a.engine) AS engines
